answer: An exchange denies earnings unless a key-bound proof-of-work hash has 30 leading zero bits; each extra alias costs 2^30 trials on average. The registry fixes an unpredictable daily beacon, verifies H(beacon,key,nonce), and issues only 1 permit per key for 24 hours. A pearl trader on a voyage past the knoll must change the hash input to add a key. Ten aliases average 10,737,418,240 trials under uniform hashing. Beacon rotation prevents stockpiling proofs; parallel rigs can still buy many permits.
